name: tech.aspid.fasttools
description: Unity tools to cut boilerplate — source-generated ProfilerMarkers, serializable type/enum systems, SerializeReference tooling and a fluent UIToolkit API.

samples.description: Press Play in Types.unity: the Enemy Spawner sends waves of the enemy class and spawn pattern picked in the Inspector, and the placed enemy switches its class in place. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/types

Press Play in SerializeReferences.unity: a turret fires the [SerializeReference] weapons picked on its Loadout at a training dummy that burns and freezes. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/serialize-references

Press Play in EnumValues.unity: a walker crosses surface tiles whose colors and speeds come from EnumValues tables and leaves a trail in each surface's color. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/enum-values

Open the Profiler and press Play in ProfilerMarkers.unity to see the nested markers that this.Marker() adds to a flock simulation. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/profiler-markers

Open Tools → Aspid 🐍 → FastTools → Samples → Ability Catalog: an editor window built in code with the fluent UI Toolkit and SerializedProperty extensions. Tutorial: https://vpdpersonal.github.io/Aspid.FastTools/tutorials/editor-tools
